contract_summary: CP1-owned one-shot wrapper passed to PRT: invokes the original inner census exactly once, builds a bounded exact-JSON copy, hashes its canonical bytes, returns exactly that copy; no deadline renewal
consumed_sha256 == CP2 log.served_sha256() == endedness.census.served_sha256; all digests in the receipt; mismatch/failure -> nonpositive CP1_ENDEDNESS
supplements, not replaces, the one-shot nonce bind plus identical original deadline_check and identical inner census callable
evaluate_endedness receives the original inner callable, never the wrapper; refused/unbound/repeated bind or a second wrapper call poisons/refuses the transaction
copy caps cover the PRT 200000-row limit yet stay finite; over-cap, malformed, hash or copy failure is nonpositive, never a synthetic empty success

freeze exact canonical encoding, caps and source pins in CP1 plan v3 after the v6 pins; re-check the v6 interface before any repin; BaseException retention/priority preserved through copy, hash and finalization

provisional_census_copy_design_to_freeze.status: PROVISIONAL: derived from PRT v5 82feb74c _take_census 1079-1094 and CP2 v5 7a512b8e census 1001-1003 / start_fingerprint 445-448 (both self-HOLD); must be re-verified against the v6 pins before plan v3 freezes it.
provisional_census_copy_design_to_freeze.accepted_shape: exact dict with exactly {complete, processes, observed_at_mono}; complete exact bool; observed_at_mono exact finite float; processes exact list, 0..200000 rows (= PRT MAX_TREE_ENTRIES and CP2 MAX_ROWS); each row exact dict with exactly {pid, ppid, pgid, uid, start_fingerprint}; pid/ppid/pgid/uid exact int in 0..4294967295 (CP2 emits u32 values, euid for uid); start_fingerprint exact str of 1..64 chars from [A-Za-z0-9:-] (CP2 canonical sv19-incarnation-v1 fingerprints are at most 63 chars from this set and need no JSON escaping)
provisional_census_copy_design_to_freeze.deliberately_stricter_than_PRT: PRT itself accepts unbounded nonnegative ints and 1..512-char text; CP1 binds the copy to the pinned CP2 census schema (scheme sv19-incarnation-v1 is already a pinned CP1 version field). Anything outside these bounds is refused by the wrapper (PRT then fires P4_CENSUS_FAILED; HELD), never truncated or replaced.
provisional_census_copy_design_to_freeze.canonical_encoding: identical to CP1/PRT/CP2 _canonical: json.dumps(sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False, separators=(",",":")) + LF, ASCII bytes; consumed_sha256 = sha256 of those bytes
provisional_census_copy_design_to_freeze.byte_bound_derivation: max row 158 bytes; envelope 78 bytes including LF and max 24-char float repr; 200000 rows + 199999 commas -> 31,800,077 bytes worst case; frozen cap 32 MiB (33,554,432) therefore never refuses an in-bounds snapshot
provisional_census_copy_design_to_freeze.copy_rules: iterative bounded walk with exact type checks only (no isinstance, no user hooks); fresh dict/list containers, immutable str/int/float/bool values reused; canonical encoding and hash of the fresh copy; PRT receives that fresh copy; CP1 keeps only digest, byte length and row count (not the snapshot)
provisional_census_copy_design_to_freeze.deadline: no renewal; PRT's own post-callback original-deadline completion check covers the wrapper's copy/hash time; the wrapper additionally checks the identical original predicate after hashing, immediately before return, and refuses on a crossing
provisional_census_copy_design_to_freeze.exceptions: any BaseException from the inner census, copy, hash or deadline check is retained in the CP1 ledger at encounter before propagation; ordinary failures become a CP1-recorded refusal raised to PRT; a second wrapper call raises a refusal and latches the transaction nonpositive
